issues.title: Two of its Java changes do not fit Build 42.22
issues.note: ZombieBuddy cannot apply its changes to a weapon's knockdown (HandWeapon.getKnockdownMod) and to a zombie being hit (IsoZombie.Hit): the game's methods use other number types than the mod expects. Body weight does not change those two parts of combat; the mod's other changes load. Nothing to do until its author updates it.
